description: A compact pixel-art Ready status icon: a clearly recognizable check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. Use the uploaded style anchor for the queue family art language: perceptible cool blue accent, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges, restrained shading/detail. Static standalone symbol on transparent background, readable at 16x16 and at 3x nearest on dark #172336. Keep the success silhouette distinct from activity, retry and pause symbols without depending on color. Do not add text. No fixed palette is imposed.

style_image.usage_description: Style only: exact preserved controlled-fixture Ready reference, adopted queue family treatment; preserve compact readable clusters, cool-blue accent and transparency. This reference is not evidence of real historical generation.
